text: Slide 1: Problem Statement & Context (1.5 minutes) "Good morning, everyone! I'm presenting on behalf of Team Agile Innovators for the Problem statement accelerating Indian road network modelling. The Core Problem: Current urban planning software assumes ideal road conditions typical of developed countries. But Indian roads are different - we have potholes, temporary barricades, construction zones, and unpredictable driver behaviours. The Gap: Manually modelling these complex Indian road features into virtual road network is repetitive and time-consuming. Engineers spend weeks creating realistic models before they can even begin traffic simulation. Challenge: Our Goal is to create toolsets and workflows that seamlessly integrate with MATLAB, Simulink, and Roadrunner to rapidly generate high-fidelity virtual road network of Indian road networks . Slide 2: Architecture (2 minutes) Component 1: Multi-Source Data Integration • Real-time feeds from OpenStreetMap, Google Maps, social media traffic reports, and Government of India traffic reports. • Apache Kafka streams process this data continuously. • AI models identify Indian-specific road features automatically. Component 2: Indian Road Feature Library • Pre-built asset libraries for potholes, construction zones, and temporary barricades. • Templates that capture Indian traffic behaviours - lane discipline variations, mixed vehicle types, pedestrian patterns • Reusable components that integrate directly with Roadrunner’s asset system. Slide 3: Technical Deep Dive - Indian Road Modelling (2.5 minutes) • "Let me show you how we make asset libraries for potholes, construction zones, and temporary barricades.: Real-Time Data Processing Pipeline: • Data Collection: Multiple sources like OpenStreetMap, Government portals, Google Traffic, WAZE API, traffic cameras data are used. • Stream Processing: Kafka collects data, Apache Flink processes streams, NiFi validates information • AI Fusion Engine: Models analyze text and location data to make intelligent road condition decisions • MATLAB Integration: APIs deliver clean, structured data directly to simulation environment Indian Road Asset Library Development: Pothole Detection & Modelling: • AI detects potholes from satellite images and social media reports. • Automatically creates 3D pothole models with realistic depth variations. • Simulated vehicles slow down and change lanes around potholes naturally. Dynamic Barricade System: • Monitors social media and government announcements for real-time traffic diversions • Automatically places appropriate assets - cones, barriers, construction signs. • Updates propagate to MATLAB simulations within minutes Construction Zone Modelling: • Template system combines blocked lanes, warning signs, and equipment placement • Rapid deployment for common Indian construction scenarios • Integrates with Simulink for complex traffic management sequences" Slide 4: Workflow Integration with MATLAB Ecosystem (1.5 minutes) "Our solution seamlessly plugs into existing MathWorks workflows: Final Stage - MATLAB Export: • Road networks and assets

Slide 5: Technical Feasibility & Innovation (1 minute) "Our technical stack leverages proven technologies: AI & Data Processing: • Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming • TensorFlow models trained on Indian road imagery • Custom APIs for integrating diverse data sources MATLAB Ecosystem Integration: • Built using MATLAB's supported file formats and APIs • Extends existing Roadrunner functionality rather than replacing it • Maintains full compatibility with Automated Driving Toolbox Scalability & Deployment: • Cloud-native architecture supports multiple cities simultaneously • Modular design allows incremental feature additions • Docker containers enable easy deployment across government agencies" Slide 7: Impact for Traffic Management Agencies (0.5 minutes) For Traffic Engineers: Rapid scenario testing enables proactive infrastructure planning instead of reactive crisis management For Municipal Authorities: Cost-effective simulation of proposed changes

Slide 7: Impact for Traffic Management Agencies (0.5 minutes) For Traffic Engineers: Rapid scenario testing enables proactive infrastructure planning instead of reactive crisis management For Municipal Authorities: Cost-effective simulation of proposed changes before expensive real- world implementation For Emergency Management: Crisis scenarios can be modelled and tested with accurate Indian road conditions For Urban Planners: Data-driven insights for long-term infrastructure development with realistic traffic modelling" Slide 8: Closing & Technical Readiness (0.5 minutes) "We've created the missing link between Indian road realities and MATLAB's powerful simulation capabilities. Our solution directly addresses MathWorks' challenge by providing toolsets and workflows that dramatically accelerate high-fidelity digital twin creation. We're set to use this solution to make Indian traffic simulation as advanced as the problems on our roads. Thank you . Slide 9: Demonstration - From Data to Simulation (1.5 minutes) "Here's our workflow in action: Step 1: Data Ingestion (Real-time) • System monitors Delhi's Connaught Place junction • Detects ongoing construction, identifies pothole reports from Twitter • Maps current traffic diversions from Google Maps API Step 2: Automated Model Generation (5 minutes) • AI places construction barriers based on satellite imagery • Pothole models generated with appropriate vehicle impact zones • Traffic behaviour templates applied based on historical patterns Step 3: MATLAB Export (2 minutes) • Complete scenario exported as OpenDRIVE file • Imported into Driving Scenario Designer with all Indian features intact • Ready for crisis simulation, congestion testing, or infrastructure planning Result: What previously took 2-3 weeks of manual modelling now happens in under 10 minutes, with
